response: According to various studies, tuberculosis (TB) patients in China generally have a high adherence rate to prescribed treatments, thanks to the country's directly observed treatment, short-course (DOTS) strategy and other initiatives. However, some patients may still face challenges, such as long treatment durations, side effects, and socioeconomic factors, which can affect adherence. Overall, China has made significant progress in improving TB treatment adherence, but continued efforts are needed to address remaining barriers and ensure all patients complete their full treatment course.
